subject.title: [Bug]: openai-responses sends role="system" instead of role="developer" for reasoning models

question: For custom `openai-responses` providers, should OpenClaw support strict relays that reject prompt messages in `input` by adding an opt-in instructions-placement mode, by extending existing developer-role compat, or by leaving those relays on `openai-completions`/external workarounds?
rationale: The failure is credible, but the safe default is a product/API contract choice because other OpenAI-compatible providers have the opposite compatibility requirements.

options.title: Sponsor opt-in placement
options.body: Keep current defaults and land a documented opt-in request-shape mode with tests for strict Responses relays.

options.title: Use developer-role compat
options.body: Extend the existing `supportsDeveloperRole` semantics to Responses without adding a separate prompt-placement key.

options.title: Decline core support
options.body: Keep proxy Responses defaults unchanged and direct affected users to `openai-completions` or relay-specific integration work.

recommendation.title: Sponsor opt-in placement
recommendation.body: Keep current defaults and land a documented opt-in request-shape mode with tests for strict Responses relays.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the current Responses developer-role compatibility path and have the strongest recent history on this request-shaping boundary.
